**Asset:** HSM.F1.GBX01 | **Scenario:** SCN-038 | **Generated:** 2026-06-11

## 1. Diagnosis

Asset is a Flender H4SH mill-drive reduction gearbox (6,000 kW, ISO VG 220) classified Criticality-1 [8]. Active failure mode is **gear_tooth_fatigue_crack** [1]. Oil viscosity sensor `JSR.HR.STD1.GBX01.OIL.VISC` reads **216.601** — in WARNING band (warn 180, alarm 265) [2]. The ML fault classifier currently returns NORMAL (P=0.9999) [2]; however, ML confidence does not override the confirmed failure mode — chip-detector alarm or spall confirmation is an **immediate-stop event, no deferral permitted** [8].

---

## 2. Root Cause

Tooth-root fatigue crack initiated by a prior **high-torque cobble event**; chunky spall debris now present in the oil circuit [1][4]. Cobble events are the primary tooth fatigue initiator on this asset; CMMS should flag any torque exceedance >110% rated for >5 seconds as a precursor trigger [9].

---

## 3. Remaining Useful Life

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Estimated RUL | **632 cycles (~26.3 days)** [3] |
| RUL Band | **MONITOR** [3] |

> ⚠️ RUL trajectory is a statistical estimate. Given confirmed spall debris and a 36-week spare lead time [6], **do not use remaining RUL as justification for deferral.** A catastrophic fracture will eliminate any remaining cycle budget instantly.

---

## 4. Risk Classification

**Overall Risk: HIGH (Score 7/10)** [5]

| Factor | Contribution |
|---|---|
| Process criticality (Criticality-1) | +3 [5] |
| Safety class P2 | +2 [5] |
| P(failure) from ML = 0.00 | +0 [5] |
| RUL band = MONITOR | +0 [5] |
| Key spare GEAR-WHL-M20 out-of-stock, 36-wk lead | +2 [5] |

The spare stockout is the dominant risk amplifier. Without the gear wheel in hand, any fracture event locks the asset for up to 36 weeks [6].

---

## 5. Recommended Actions

Execute **SOP-02 Option B (Major Overhaul)** [8]. Steps in sequence [4][6]:

1. **Immediate controlled stop** — no deferral once spall or crack is confirmed [4][8]
2. **Remove gearbox via crane** to repair bay [4][6]
3. Inspect all gear teeth under workshop lighting; classify damage per **AGMA 2101-D04** (pitting, spalling, micro-pitting, scuffing, tooth-root fracture); photograph every tooth with reference-mark numbering [10]
4. Remove damaged gear wheel/pinion via hydraulic press; if shrink-fit, apply localised induction heat to gear boss only — **no direct flame** (annealing risk) [10]
5. Inspect shaft gear seat for fretting/wear; measure vs OEM tolerance; regrind + chrome-spray if worn [10]
6. **Replace gear wheel + bearings** — replace bearings as an opportunity task regardless of bearing condition; bearing cost is negligible vs gearbox removal labour [11]
7. **Set backlash 0.1–0.3 mm** — measure with dial gauge at minimum 8 positions around circumference; confirm against Flender H4SH drawing [11]
8. **Prussian-blue contact check** — apply to 3–5 adjacent teeth, rotate under light torque; contact must be **>70% face width and >60% tooth height** [11]
9. **Run-in at low load** before returning to full drive train torque [4][6]

**Planned downtime:** 0 h planned / **168 h unplanned** if fracture occurs before controlled intervention [1].

---

| Action | Part | Description | Status | Lead Time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **ORDER NOW** | `GEAR-WHL-M20` | Custom large-module gear wheel M20+ (HSM mill drive) — Flender / Renk OEM | ❌ Out of stock | **36 weeks** [6][9] |
| **ISSUE FROM STORE** | `BRG-GBX-SET` | Gearbox bearing set | ✅ 1 on hand | Immediate [6] |

> GEAR-WHL-M20 must be ordered immediately. Waiting for further degradation evidence means operating without a recovery path. Per recurrence prevention guidance, the order trigger should be raised as soon as ferrous particles first trend above 5 ppm — waiting until fracture is operationally indefensible given the 36-week lead [9].

The USD 600k estimate reflects a ~7-day gear wheel swap plus secondary-damage repair; the range extends to USD 3M if the fracture event causes cascading damage requiring extended shutdown [1].

## 8. Recurrence Prevention

- Monthly **ferrographic oil analysis** — mandatory; ferrography detects spall particles 2–4 weeks before GMF alarm escalates [9]
- Implement **kidney-loop filtration**, target ISO 4406 < 16/14/11 continuously [9]
- Connect **torque measurement to CMMS**; auto-raise work order if torque exceeds 110% rated for >5 seconds [9]
- Enforce **run-in procedure** after every gear replacement [9]
